(delta2 X w).mulVec (IwahoriHecke.TensorEmbedGL.δ y) = fun (x : Fin d × Fin d) => (X x.1 y.1 * if x.2 = y.2 then w y.2 else 0) + (if x.1 = y.1 then 1 else 0) * X x.2 y.2
